name: hf_objaverse_glb_shard
title: Objaverse 1.0, one shard of glTF meshes (5 000 objects)
description: Objaverse hosts 800k+ Sketchfab objects as .glb under glbs/<shard>/<uid>.glb (160 shards of 5 000). This manifest lists one shard; pl.load('hf://allenai/objaverse/glbs/000-017') picks another. glTF fixes the frame: Y-up, metres. Object metadata (names, categories, per-object licences) is in metadata/ and object-paths.json.gz at the repo root.

license.note: ODC-By 1.0 for the collection (Hub card, checked 2026-10-13); every object keeps its own Creative Commons licence from Sketchfab (CC BY, CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND...), recorded in the metadata. Commercial use and redistribution are TO CONFIRM per object from that metadata.

citation: Deitke M., Schwenk D., Salvador J., et al. Objaverse: A Universe of Annotated 3D Objects. CVPR 2023.

mesh.description: Textured glTF binary mesh (Y-up, metres by the glTF specification)
